items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: The interviewee mentions Willie Humphrey only in the context of John Handy and Willie Humphrey playing together, and in relation to John enrolling Willie in a club. No direct personal interaction or relationship between the interviewee (Moose Zanco) and Willie Humphrey is described.

ctx.x: Bob Ice should have it. Yeah, I think he has his address and all, you know. He's gonna keep contact with him. Incidentally, John enrolled Willie as a correspondent member in New Orleans Jazz Club, you know. So that's one more finger reaching out across the sea, you know. So Willie's a member now, I think.
Let's get all the men in the band straight while we're talking about all that. Who was with the band when you first joined?
